_comment: Provenance of public/models/kd-hang-tuah-exterior.glb (3D Ship Explorer). Phase 1: 4 November 2026; Phase 2: 5 November 2026. Research file: not built into the site. The model is regenerated by scripts/build-ship-model.mjs.
Status: Approximate reconstruction (Phase 2 prototype). Not an exact replica. The internal structure is conceptual.

Internal_Modelling_References.Owner_Decision: 4 November 2026: unapproved, non-operational images from the TLDM folder may be used ONLY as internal modelling references. They are not copied into the project, not published and not used as textures. All Op Fajar frames are excluded.
Used: gambar kdhangtuah/F76-HMS-Mermaid-Side View.jpg — third-party profile drawing (726×323) with a 100 m scale bar; positions along the ship and heights of the superstructure, masts, funnel and guns were measured from it (6.55 px per metre). Its scale is consistent with 103.5 m overall.

gambar kdhangtuah/Pengenalan KD HANG TUAH F76.pptx.pdf (SRC038) — p.2 specifications; pp.10–13 Limbo, guns, STD/training bridge, boats; p.19 2022 slipping photographs (hull colours, rudder); pp.21, 25, 26 photographs labelled RADAR, GUN, BOAT, CRANE, Y GUN PORT & STBD, PORT SIDE, PORT QUARTER, PORT MIDSHIP, GELADAK HALUAN, HELI DECK, LALUAN STBD; p.28 No. 1 deck plan (deck outline proportions, positions of the helideck, boat decks and A gun).
gambar kdhangtuah/KD_Hang_Tuah_Labuan_20070915.jpg — later TLDM configuration, starboard side (third-party).
gambar kdhangtuah/201512290845360.C1 Mermaid portside departs Freemantle mid 70s.jpg — Royal Navy era, port side (third-party).
Internal_Modelling_References.Not_Used: All Op Fajar 2009 frames; the RESTRICTED equipment list; the personal forms; the hero image deleted by the owner.

From_Sources: Length overall 103.5 m (SRC038 p.2; SRC016 gives 339 ft 7 in overall).
Draught 4.9 m, modelled as waterline to bottom of keel (SRC038 p.2). Loading condition not stated.
Height 'Tinggi' 22.05 m (SRC038 p.2): NOT mapped to the model. In the model the foremast platform happens to be about 22 m above the waterline; this is not evidence of what 'Tinggi' measures.
As built: twin 4-inch Mk16 gun (A position), STD above the bridge, Limbo Mk10 on the flight deck (SRC038 pp.10–12).

Later: Bofors 57 mm/L70 (A position), training bridge on the former STD position, two Bofors 40 mm/L70 at Y port and starboard, Limbo last operated in 2000 (SRC038 pp.10–12, 25). The gun change dates are not recorded.
Boats: Captain's Barge and Sea Boat Whaler, replaced by 7.62 m RHIBs in October 2001 (SRC038 p.13).
Assumptions_And_Approximations: Hull lines (sheer, deck outline, sections, bow and stern rake, keel cut-up aft) are estimates; only length, beam and draught are sourced.
Deck-edge height: 4.1 m above the waterline aft rising to 5.6 m at the bow (profile drawing).

Superstructure modelled as simple blocks: No. 01 level to 7.6 m, No. 02 level to 10.5 m, bridge to 12.1 m above the waterline (profile drawing); widths estimated (after deckhouse 7.6 m, forward block 10.2 m, No. 02 level 9.0 m).
Funnel: elliptical streamlined shape 6.1 m long, about 4 m wide (width estimated), top about 15.1 m above the waterline.

Foremast: lower tower and darker upper tower to about 21.5 m; antennas are generic shapes. As built follows 1970s images; Later follows 2022 photographs. Radar types not identified; change dates unknown.
After mast: about 15.4 m plus a pole (profile drawing).
Boats: generic shapes in both configurations; the 2001 change to RHIBs and the boat crane are not modelled.
Guns: approximate mounting shapes. 4-inch mount 3.7 m long with 4.2 m barrels; 57 mm turret on a base ring; 40 mm turrets at Y port and starboard (later only).
The 40 mm/L60 guns are not shown in the As built configuration because the date they were first fitted is not recorded.
Masts, funnel and superstructure are the same in both configurations except the STD/training bridge and the antennas.
Rudder (one) and propellers are simplified; sizes and positions estimated from the 2022 slipping photographs.

Not modelled: railings, bollards, capstans, anchors, davits, crane, aerials, life rafts, ladders, windows other than the bridge front, pennant number and markings except the helicopter landing circle.
Discrepancies_Recorded: Main gun mark: SRC038 says 'Mk16'; two images in the reference folder say 'Mk19 102 mm'. The briefing's wording is used.
Length: 103.5 m (SRC038, SRC016) vs about 105.1 m (SRC015) and 105 / 105.15 m (newspapers).
Draught: 4.9 m (SRC038) vs about 3.7 m (SRC015) and 5.1 m (newspaper).
Evidence_Needed: Approved general-arrangement or profile drawings (TLDM or Yarrow) to replace the estimated hull lines and heights.
What 'Tinggi 22.05 m' measures, so a height line can be drawn.
Approved exterior photographs (port and starboard profile, bow, stern, from above) for the superstructure widths, masts and antennas.
Dates of the gun changes (4-inch to 57 mm; 40 mm L60 to L70) and of the radar changes.
Whether 40 mm guns were fitted when the ship arrived in 1977, and where.
The radar types, to name the antennas.
A source naming the quarterdeck, to add it as a part.

Additional_References: SRC038 p.28 No. 1 deck plan (native image 2000×511): deck fittings (breakwater, electric capstans fore and aft, bollards, fairleads, hawse pipes, deck pipes, anchor viewing platforms, jackstaff, vent intake house), deckhouse outline and side passages, boats (BARGE, GEMINI), FASSI CRANE, helicopter landing circle. The plan shows 'BOFORS 57MM MK I', so it shows the later configuration.

SRC038 p.30 No. 3 deck plan: watertight bulkheads (W.T.B) at frames 2½, 6, 8, 10½, 14, 18½, 24, 25½, 30, 38, 44, 52, 58½, 64½, 69; compartments including the steering gear compartment, engine room (frames 52–44), machinery room (44–38), machinery control room, generator room (to frame 30) and cable locker. Frame 0 falls at the stem waterline; the frame spacing (about 1.37 m) was derived from the plan's proportions, because the plan has no scale.
SRC038 p.29 No. 2 deck plan: not traced in this phase.

SRC038 pp.25–26 photographs (2022): railings and stanchions (forecastle, starboard passage, quarterdeck), helideck safety nets and markings, ladders at the front of the superstructure, breakwater and capstan, mesh screens at the Y gun position, '76' painted on the bow with the crest, the foremast and after mast details.
SRC038 p.20: main machinery list (two Wärtsilä main engines, two gearboxes, three generator sets, two main switchboards). Used only as text; no machinery geometry is modelled.
Cross_Checks: The funnel (X 49.8–55.9 m from the stern, from the profile drawing) sits above the machinery spaces of the No. 3 deck plan (machinery room to generator room, X about 42–61 m).
The aft end of the deckhouse on the No. 1 deck plan (X about 34.6 m) agrees with the profile drawing (33.4 m).
The A gun on the deck plan (X about 87.3 m) agrees with the profile drawing (88.5 m).

Components.Geometry: Hull re-lofted: denser stations, flared topsides forward, rounded forefoot, raked stem, transom; rubbing strake along the deck edge
Components.Reference: p.2 dimensions; profile drawing; p.19 slipping photographs

Components.Geometry: Forecastle fittings: breakwater, two capstan heads, bollards, hawse and deck pipes, anchor viewing platforms with rails, jackstaff; quarterdeck capstan, bollards, vent intake house, ensign staff
Components.Support: Positions from the plan; shapes estimated
Components.Verification_Needed: Sizes of fittings; fairleads and towing fittings not modelled

Components.Geometry: Bridge with sloped front windows (8), side windows and bridge wings
Deckhouse on No. 1 deck following the deck-plan outline (narrow at the boats), roof overhangs over the side passages, No. 02 level, upper deckhouse, funnel casing; window, scuttle and door layout
Components.Reference: p.28 deck plan; p.26 'LALUAN STBD'; profile drawing
Components.Support: Plan positions; heights and openings estimated

Components.Geometry: Masts: lattice upper towers with platforms, yardarm, top poles; railings on the foremast platforms
Antennas: 1970s dish-type (as built) / planar array and bar antenna (later)
Funnel lofted from 18 elliptical sections with black top, louvre bands
Guns: twin 4-inch shield with blast bags; 57 mm turret in a raised well; 40 mm/L70 turrets with flash hiders; Limbo three-barrel mounting
Boats: as built, two generic sea boats on davits; later, two RHIBs with boat cranes
Components.Reference: p.13 (barge and whaler replaced by 7.62 m RHIBs, October 2001); p.21 'BOAT', 'CRANE'; p.28 'BARGE', 'FASSI CRANE'
Components.Support: Estimated; which as-built boat was on which side is not recorded
Components.Verification_Needed: Boat and davit positions as built; the GEMINI boats on the deck plan are not modelled

Components.Geometry: Y gun platform with mesh screens
Components.Verification_Needed: Whether the screens existed as built

Components.Geometry: Helideck markings (circle, centreline, transverse line) and angled safety nets along both edges
Four-bladed propellers with A-brackets and shafts outside the hull; one rudder
Pennant marking painted on both sides of the forward hull: 'F76' black (as built), '76' light grey with dark shadow (later); vertices placed on the hull surface
Components.Reference: p.19, p.25 photographs ('76'); Royal Navy-era images ('F76')
Components.Support: Text supported; lettering style and size estimated
Components.Verification_Needed: Original lettering drawings; when the marking changed; the crest is not modelled

Components.Geometry: Railings: forecastle, main-deck sides, quarterdeck and transom, 01 deck, 02 deck, bridge wings and bridge top, foremast platforms, anchor viewing platforms; stanchions about every 1.6 m, two or three rails
Components.Support: Presence supported; arrangement, spacing and openings estimated
Components.Verification_Needed: Railing arrangement as built; gangway and gate openings

Components.Geometry: Ladders: two at the front of the superstructure (photograph), two to the No. 02 level and one aft (estimated)
Deck levels No. 2 (about +1.75 m) and No. 3 (about −0.85 m) as flat plates
Fifteen transverse watertight bulkheads at the plan's frames, drawn keel to No. 1 deck
Compartments between their bulkheads: engine room, machinery room, machinery control room, generator room, steering gear compartment, cable locker
Two shaft lines inside the hull as straight lines

Not_Modelled: Main engines, gearboxes, generators and pipework (layout not documented).
Longitudinal structural members and the keel structure (not documented).
No. 2 deck compartments; the GEMINI boats on the deck plan; fairleads, towing fittings, lifebuoys, life rafts, aerials, lights, the ship's crest and the stern name.

Phase_3.Summary: Structural correction of the forward superstructure (main bridge on the 01 deck, training bridge one level above it on the 02 deck, ceremonial platform at the former STD position); detailed but approximate interiors of the main bridge, training bridge, wheelhouse, engine room and generator room; Y gun mountings rebuilt and moved to about ±3.9 m. A historically informed reconstruction, not a dimensionally accurate replica.
Phase_3.Evidence_Register: research/evidence-register.json (per component: reference photos, source pages, what is directly visible, what comes from the deck plan, what is estimated or inferred, and status: Supported / Approximate Reconstruction / Pending Verification).

New_Sources.SRC058: Exhibition board on the STD to training bridge conversion (secondary; statements recorded as "Stated on the exhibition board").
New_Sources.SRC059: Exhibition board on the gun changes (secondary).
New_Sources.SRC060: Site-visit photographs, 2026 (internal modelling reference only; not published, not embedded, not in the ZIP).

Deck_Levels_Used._note: Heights are estimates (metres above the waterline); the deck plans give the arrangement but no heights.

Plan_Positions.Main bridge: 01 Deck plan p.31: enclosed bridge about frames 17 to 13½ (X 78.5–84.2 m), chamfered forward corners.
Plan_Positions.Training bridge: 02 Signal Deck plan p.32: frames 20 to about 16 (X 74.2–79.8 m), about 3.24 m wide.
Plan_Positions.Ceremonial platform: p.32: octagonal enclosure forward of the training bridge (X 79.15–83.85 m).
Plan_Positions.01-to-02 ladders: p.32: port and starboard, about frames 20 to 18½.
Plan_Positions.02 deck house: p.32: frames 31 to 23½, about 5.4 m wide.
Plan_Positions.Wheelhouse: No. 2 deck plan p.29: about frames 41 to 39, near the centreline (size estimated).
Plan_Positions.Y gun mountings: 01 Deck plan p.31: about frame 48½, about ±3.9 m from the centreline.
Plan_Positions.Frame mapping: X = 101.8 − 1.372 × frame (derived in Phase 2 from the plans).

Not_Modelled: The unidentified deck structure in photographs AN201/AN202 (registered as Pending Verification; position unknown).
Real pipe routes, machinery clearances, engine-room dimensions; the exhaust route beyond the engine room.
Labels, screen content, control layouts, gauges, communication equipment identity.
Machinery room, MCR and other compartments beyond the five inspected spaces.
Removed_or_Changed_from_Phase_2: Separate bridge storey at 10.5–12.1 m removed (main bridge now 7.6–10.5 m).
Training bridge moved down one level and resized from 4.1 x 4.3 m to 5.6 x 3.24 m.
STD moved down one level to the 02 deck.
Two ladders at the after end of the 02 deck removed (not on p.32).
40 mm mountings moved from ±2.0 m to ±3.9 m; Y gun platform widened; mesh screens now later configuration only.
Engine room no longer empty: approximate machinery added (the conceptual compartment remains in the Internal display).
